A Lagos-based photographer, Eman Pictures, whose bag containing a MacBook Pro and four external hard drives was stolen at the Oriental Hotel, Lagos, has recovered all the items after offering a N500,000 reward for information leading to their recovery. The bag was reportedly stolen from the bride’s room on October 31 while the photographer was covering a wedding at the hotel. The four external hard drives contained footage from five weddings yet to be delivered to the couples, raising concerns about the possible loss of important memories and the photographer’s work. Following the incident, Eman Pictures took to social media to seek public assistance, sharing a now-viral CCTV footage showing a man allegedly entering the room, taking the bag and leaving the hotel. In the appeal, the photographer explained that the stolen items included a MacBook Pro M1 and four hard drives containing footage from the five weddings. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. Add us to your Preferred Sources He also announced a N500,000 reward for credible information that could lead to the identification of the suspect and the recovery of the belongings through the appropriate authorities. The appeal was widely circulated on social media, with photographers, videographers, blogs and other users sharing the footage and calling for information that could help trace the missing equipment. In an update shared on Instagram on Thursday, Eman Pictures announced that the MacBook and all four hard drives had been recovered, although the files on the drives had been formatted. “I’m grateful to announce that my stolen MacBook and all four hard drives have been recovered. “Although the hard drives had already been formatted, I’m thankful to have my equipment back,” the photographer wrote. Eman Pictures thanked those who helped amplify the appeal, saying the reposts, tags, calls, messages, prayers and other efforts had exceeded expectations. The photographer also thanked blogs, fellow creatives, friends and strangers who took time to share the story and offer support. The recovery was also confirmed by the event planner, Ms Deeeee, who had initially raised the alarm on X. In an update, she wrote, “Every item has been recovered; even though he formatted the files. it can still be retrieved back. A big thank you to everyone who came through to help out.
